If it says 'delayed,' mine's gonna say the same thing. I can do nothing about the weather on that planet.|Densin Clord to a traveler|}} '''Densin Clord''' was a [[human]] [[Gender|male]] [[deck officer]] who worked at a [[spaceport]] on the [[planet]] [[Daiyu]]. In [[9 BBY]], he dismissed a traveler seeking help about a delayed [[transport]] when he was approached by the fugitive [[Jedi]] [[Obi-Wan Kenobi]], who explained that he was tracking a [[starship]]. Clord clarified to Kenobi that all signatures at Daiyu were blocked and walked away. ==Biography== {{Quote|Excuse me. I'm looking for a ship. I was tracking its signature.''"
"''You're in Daiyu now. All signals in or out are blocked. People like their secrets out here.|Obi-Wan Kenobi and Clord|}} [[File:BenKenobiDensinClord-OWKpII.png|thumb|left|300px|Obi-Wan Kenobi seeks assistance from Clord.]] During the [[Imperial Era|time]] of the [[Galactic Empire]], Densin Clord worked as a [[deck officer]] and attendant of a [[spaceport]] on the [[planet]] [[Daiyu]]. In [[9 BBY]],{{KenobiDate|II}} he was approached by a traveler who had learned that their [[transport]] had been delayed due to weather on another world. The traveler sought help from Clord, but the deck [[officer]] denied that he could be of any assistance, clarifying that his [[datapad]] would only show the same case and that he could not change weather. Clord waved off the traveler, only to be approached by another, the fugitive [[Jedi]] [[Obi-Wan Kenobi]], who had arrived [[Search for Princess Leia|in search]] of the [[Ambush on Alderaan|kidnapped]] [[Alderaanian]] [[Princess]] [[Leia Skywalker Organa Solo|Leia Organa]]. Kenobi explained to Clord that he was looking for a [[starship]] that's signature had been tracked to Daiyu. Clord, though, replied that all signatures going in or out of Daiyu were blocked as people liked to keep there secrets there. After his explanation, the deck officer walked away from the Jedi. ==Personality and traits== {{Quote|I really— I don't have time for this. Just be going, okay?|Clord to a traveler|}} Densin Clord was a [[human]] male with [[Color|light]] skin and brown [[hair]]. He was dismissive of any travelers he was unable to help, restarting his sentences as he explained the matter to them and considering their cases unworthy of his time. ==Equipment== Clord wore a gray shirt and trousers and a brown tunic, hat and [[boot]]s. The deck officer also used an earpiece and a datapad. ==Behind the scenes== Densin Clord appeared in "[[Part II]]" of the [[Disney+]] live-action television series ''[[Star Wars: Obi-Wan Kenobi]]'', directed by [[Deborah Chow]] and released on [[May 27]], [[2022]].{{SW|url=news/obi-wan-kenobi-may-27|text=''Obi-Wan Kenobi'' to Premiere May 27 with Two Episodes}} Identified in the credits as "Deck Officer Densin Clord," the character was portrayed by [[Dan Considine]]. The [[2023 Topps Star Wars Chrome|2023 Topps ''Star Wars'' Chrome]] card set included an autograph card for Considine that spells the character's name as "Chord."{{Topps|set=2023 Topps Star Wars Chrome|cardname=Dan Considine as Deck Officer Densin Chord|nobackup=1}} ==Appearances== *{{Kenobi|Part II}} {{1st}} *[[Obi-Wan Kenobi 2|''Obi-Wan Kenobi'' 2]] ==Sources== *{{Topps|set=2023 Topps Star Wars Chrome|cardname=Dan Considine as Deck Officer Densin Chord|nobackup=1}} {{ID|Densin Chord}} *''[[Star Wars Encyclopedia: The Comprehensive Guide to the Star Wars Galaxy]]'' ==Notes and references== {{Reflist}} {{Interlang |de=Densin Clord |es=Densin Clord |fr=Densin Clord |ja=デンシン・クロード |ka=დენსინ კლორდი |nl=Densin Clord |pl=Densin Clord }} {{DEFAULTSORT:Clord, Densin}} [[Category:Humans]] [[Category:Males]]
